title: Construction Project Manager
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Construction Project Manager to oversee and manage construction projects from planning through completion, ensuring timely delivery, cost control, quality, and compliance with safety standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan, coordinate, and monitor all construction activities to ensure timely project completion.
* Manage project budgets, cost estimates, billing, and expenditure.
* Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants, contractors, and vendors.
* Supervise site execution to ensure quality and compliance with approved drawings and specifications.
* Prepare project schedules, track progress, and implement corrective measures to avoid delays.
* Manage procurement, material planning, and contractor coordination.
* Monitor labour productivity, resource allocation, and site performance.
* Conduct regular site meetings and prepare progress reports for management and clients.
* Ensure compliance with building regulations, safety standards, and statutory requirements.
* Identify project risks and resolve technical and execution-related issues.
* Review contractor bills, variations, and additional works.
* Ensure proper documentation, snagging, handover, and project closeout.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or Construction Management.
* Strong knowledge of construction methods, materials, and project execution.
* Experience in project planning, budgeting, contract management, and quality control.
* Proficiency in MS Project, Excel, AutoCAD, and other relevant project management tools.
* Excellent leadership, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and deliver projects within agreed timelines and budgets.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely project completion.
* Adherence to approved budgets.
* Quality of construction and reduction in rework.
* Effective contractor and resource management.
* Compliance with safety standards.
* Client satisfaction and successful project handover.

Pay: ₹60,000.00 - ₹100,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Project Erection Engineer-Electrical
description:
**Job Requirements**  

The **Erection Lead** at **Jakson Limited**—Power generation projects—plays a crucial leadership role in managing all aspects of site execution from site mobilization till handing over the Project.

**1. Site Mobilisation**

* Study of contract for scope, technical, safety, quality and statutory requirement.
* Site visit and kick off meeting with customer / PMC site staff.
* Contractor finalisation in coordination with Project Controller.
* Allocation of Site Engineer.
* Site Mobilisation (Establishment of Site office / Store, deployment of required staff like HSE / Quality engineer.)

**2. Site Installation Management**

* Oversee erection and installation of all electrical/mechanical equipment under Jakson Scope such as DG sets, transformers, BOT, Panel, switchgear, structures, etc.
* Ensure strict adherence to project specifications, technical drawings, and timelines.
* Coordinate with design, Project Controller and procurement teams for timely availability of materials and resources.
* Manage contractor deployment, allocation of tasks, and daily work progress.
* Maintenance of all statutory registers and records as per contract / statutory requirement.
* Certification from customer as per customer guidelines for all inward material at site for processing payment.
Adherence to schedule and milestone and updating as per customer requirement.  

**3. Safety Compliance**

* Implement and enforce **HSE (Health, Safety, Environment)** policies as per statutory and company norms.
* Conduct regular **site safety audits**, toolbox talks, and risk assessments.
* Ensure all site personnel use appropriate **PPE and follow safety protocols**.
* Investigate incidents/near-misses and take corrective actions.
* Conduct safety audits.

**4. Quality Assurance**

* Preparation of FQP (Field Quality Plan).
* Ensure that erection work meets **quality standards and customer expectations**.
* Implement **quality control procedures** during installation—check alignment, torque, welding quality, insulation resistance, etc.
* Maintain proper documentation of **QAP (Quality Assurance Plan)** and test records.
* Liaise with quality teams for inspections and third-party validations.
* Conduct Quality audits.

**5. Vendor and Contractor Management**

* Manage and evaluate performance of **erection contractors and service vendors**.
* Ensure contractors comply with **technical, safety, and quality requirements**.
* Handle **contractual issues**, productivity monitoring, and scope adherence.
* Approve contractor bills based on actual work completion (JMS) and milestone achievements.
* Preparation and Certification of RA bill form customer and submission.
* Development of New Contractors.

**6. Customer and PMC (Project Management Consultant) Interaction**

* Serve as the **primary point of contact** for customer site representatives and PMC.
* Attend site meetings, resolve client/PMC queries, and ensure execution aligns with expectations.
* Provide **regular updates** on progress, delays, and risk mitigation plans.
* Coordinate for client inspections, approvals, and punch list closures.

**7. Testing and Commissioning**

* Preparation of list of site test and checks.
* Plan and execute **pre-commissioning and commissioning** of systems.
* Ensure all equipment undergoes **functional and performance testing** as per contract requirement.
* Coordinate with respective OEM/ Supplier and internal teams for final testing, troubleshooting, and handover.
* Ensure timely generation of commissioning documents and **customer sign-off and handing over of Project**.

 **Work Experience**  

* Electrical Erection & Equipment Installation
* Testing & Commissioning
* Site Execution & Project Coordination
* HSE & Quality Compliance
* Contractor & Vendor Management

Coordinate civil, structural, mechanical, and electrical execution activities at site.

Ensure execution is carried out as per approved drawings, BOQ, specifications, method statements, and project schedules.

Monitor manpower, productivity, equipment utilization, and daily work progress.

Identify site issues and coordinate with relevant teams for timely resolution.

2\. Site Coordination

Coordinate with clients, EPC contractors, subcontractors, vendors, consultants, and internal project teams.

Conduct regular site inspections and monitor work fronts.

Track daily and weekly project progress against planned targets.

Ensure timely availability of materials, manpower, tools, machinery, and equipment.

Coordinate material receipt, inspection, storage, and issue at site.

Support project management in achieving scheduled milestones.

3\. Quality Assurance \& Quality Control

Ensure installation activities comply with approved drawings, specifications, QA/QC procedures, and project standards.

Coordinate inspections and closure of quality\-related observations.

Identify deviations and ensure corrective actions are implemented.

Maintain inspection records, checklists, and quality documentation.

4\. Health, Safety \& Environment

Implement and monitor site safety procedures and project HSE requirements.

Ensure workers and contractors comply with PPE and safe work practices.

Support toolbox talks, safety inspections, and hazard identification activities.

Report unsafe conditions, incidents, and near misses to the concerned team.

Ensure safe execution of civil, mechanical, electrical, and lifting activities.

5\. Documentation \& Reporting

Prepare and maintain Daily Progress Reports (DPR) and weekly progress updates.

Track manpower, material consumption, equipment utilization, and work quantities.

Prepare material reconciliation and support inventory tracking.

Maintain site records, inspection reports, checklists, work permits, and other project documentation.

Support preparation and updating of as\-built drawings and project handover documentation.

Provide regular progress updates and highlight delays, constraints, and critical site issues to management.

6\. Testing \& Commissioning Support

Support testing and commissioning activities for solar PV plant systems.

Assist in coordination of electrical testing, pre\-commissioning, commissioning, and synchronization activities.

Coordinate with electrical teams, vendors, and clients during commissioning.

Track and close project punch points and client observations.

Support final inspection, documentation, and project handover activities.

Required Qualifications

Any Degree

2–3 years of relevant experience in solar project execution, preferably in ground\-mounted solar PV projects.

Basic understanding of solar PV systems, Module Mounting Structures (MMS), civil works, and electrical execution.

Willingness to work at project sites across South India.

Required Skills

Solar project site execution and supervision.

Hands\-on experience in ground\-mounted solar projects.

Knowledge of solar structures and installation practices.

Basic understanding of DC/AC electrical systems.

Knowledge of site measurements, leveling, alignment, and structural installation.

AutoCAD and MS Office skills.

Contractor and vendor coordination.

Progress monitoring and reporting.

Documentation and record maintenance.

Good communication, coordination, and teamwork skills.

Ability to work independently at project sites.

Preferred Skills

Experience in utility\-scale solar power plant projects.

Exposure to HT/LT electrical systems.

Basic knowledge of SCADA and plant monitoring systems.

Familiarity with QA/QC procedures and inspection practices.

Knowledge of solar project safety standards and site HSE practices.

Experience working with EPC contractors and subcontractors.

description:

Ensure the highest standards of construction quality across all projects. Monitor and approve the quality of materials used at project sites. Conduct regular inspections to verify compliance with approved specifications. Identify quality deviations and implement corrective measures immediately. Maintain quality control records and reports.

**2\. Project Planning \& Execution**

Oversee end to end execution of construction activities. Prepare and monitor project schedules, milestones and completion targets. Ensure projects are delivered within approved timelines and budgets. Anticipate project risks and proactively implement mitigation plans.

title: Interior Project Manager
description:
Role Overview

The Interior Project Manager will be responsible for the **end\-to\-end execution of assigned interior projects**, ensuring that projects are delivered within the agreed **scope, timeline, budget and quality standards**.

The role involves close coordination between the **Design Team, Project Engineering Team, Factory/Manufacturing Team, vendors, contractors, suppliers and clients**.

The ideal candidate should be highly organised, technically strong, proactive in problem\-solving and comfortable taking ownership of multiple moving parts on an interior project.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Project Planning \& Execution

* Take complete ownership of assigned interior projects from design handover to final completion.
* Review the approved design, drawings, BOQ, scope of work, specifications and project requirements before execution.
* Prepare and maintain project execution schedules and milestones.
* Break down projects into activity\-wise execution plans and monitor progress against timelines.
* Coordinate dependencies between civil, electrical, carpentry, modular furniture, painting, false ceiling, flooring, plumbing and other trades.
* Identify potential execution bottlenecks in advance and take corrective action.
* Ensure projects progress according to the approved sequence and schedule.

2\. Site Management

* Conduct regular site visits and monitor day\-to\-day execution.
* Coordinate with site labour/contractors.
* Ensure site activities are executed as per approved drawings and specifications.
* Verify dimensions, levels, alignment, installation and workmanship.
* Coordinate site readiness before commencement of each activity.
* Ensure proper protection of completed works and materials at site.
* Maintain site discipline, cleanliness and safe working practices.

3\. Design \& Technical Coordination

* Review drawings and designs before execution and identify technical or site\-related issues.
* Coordinate with the Design Team to resolve design clarifications and site constraints.
* Ensure that no deviation from approved drawings is executed without appropriate approval.
* Coordinate site measurements and verify critical dimensions before manufacturing or installation.
* Ensure coordination between 2D drawings, 3D designs, BOQ, cutlists and actual site conditions.
* Identify design\-to\-execution gaps and communicate them proactively to the relevant team.

4\. Vendor \& Contractor Management

* Coordinate and manage contractors, installers, fabricators and specialised vendors.
* Allocate work and establish expected completion timelines.
* Monitor contractor performance, productivity and workmanship.
* Ensure vendors adhere to Antara Haus quality and execution standards.
* Coordinate material delivery, installation and rectification activities.
* Track pending works and ensure timely closure.
* Escalate persistent vendor performance or quality issues.

5\. Procurement \& Material Coordination

* Coordinate sourcing of required materials to ensure availability as per project schedule.
* Prepare and communicate material requirements sufficiently in advance.
* Track material orders, expected delivery dates and site requirements.
* Verify received materials against specifications and quantities where required.
* Identify material shortages, damages or specification mismatches immediately.
* Coordinate urgent procurement requirements to prevent project delays.
* Ensure materials are properly stored and handled at site.

6\. Quality Control

* Maintain high standards of workmanship across all project activities.
* Conduct regular quality inspections at critical stages.
* Check dimensions, alignment, finish, detailing, installation and functionality.
* Ensure modular furniture and site works meet approved design specifications.
* Identify defects and coordinate rectification with the responsible contractor/vendor.
* Maintain snag lists and track closure of all observations.
* Conduct pre\-handover quality inspections and ensure all punch\-list items are closed.

7\. Client Coordination

* Act as the primary project execution point of contact for the client where required.
* Communicate project progress, upcoming activities and site requirements clearly.
* Coordinate client approvals required for execution.
* Manage expectations regarding timelines, site conditions and execution requirements.
* Escalate design changes, scope changes and potential cost/time impacts to management before committing.
* Ensure client concerns are recorded, assigned and closed systematically.
* Maintain a professional and solution\-oriented relationship with clients.

8\. Project Cost \& Scope Control

* Ensure execution remains within the approved project scope and BOQ.
* Identify additional works, variations and scope changes before execution.
* Obtain appropriate approval for changes before committing resources or costs.
* Monitor material wastage and avoid unnecessary rework.
* Coordinate with the management/accounts team regarding project\-related commercial matters where required.
* Highlight potential cost overruns or commercial risks at an early stage.

9\. Project Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain accurate project documentation throughout the project lifecycle.
* Ensure all project tasks and follow\-ups are recorded in the company's task management system.
* Maintain project schedules, site reports, material requirements, snag lists and progress updates.
* Submit regular project status reports covering:
* Work completed
* Work in progress
* Planned activities
* Labour/contractor status
* Material availability
* Material requirements
* Delays and risks
* Client dependencies
* Quality issues
* Decisions/approvals required
* Ensure project information is current and accessible to the relevant internal teams.

10\. Project Handover

* Coordinate final project completion and snag closure.
* Conduct final quality checks before client handover.
* Ensure all installations, hardware, appliances, lighting and furniture are functional.
* Coordinate cleaning and final site preparation.
* Ensure project documentation and relevant warranties/manuals are collected where applicable.
* Obtain project completion and client handover confirmation.
* Coordinate post\-handover rectification during the applicable defect\-liability period.

* Project management of Strategic organization initiatives aligned with futuristics skills such as AI driven Project management and Predictive modeling, Data science analysis, sustainability initiatives
* Implement the required Agile methodology effectively – Scrum / Kanban / Nexus / SAFe / Other
* Ensure the development team follows established product development procedures and practices to leverage shared organizational knowledge and experience
* Manage and coach our teams on the industry’s best agile practices
* Radiate information to promote accountability and continuous improvement
* Focus on process optimization, value delivery, Business value realization, connecting Agile to customer needs
* Provide practical expertise, ensuring teams run efficiently and work aligns with business value
* Align Agile initiatives with business goals, focusing on scaling, governance, and strategic outcomes
* Adhere to general project management principles of Project scope management, time management, cost management, risk management and stakeholder management
* Manage ETC PPM project portfolio / Project agreements of respective teams and publish the monthly billing data for the respective teams
* Lead/Assist Annual Operating Planning (AOP) discussions with respective SBUs/NOEs and corporate teams
* Collaborate to continuously improve process, systems and develop/refine standard works


**What you will bring:**


* Expertise in **Program / Project management, Agile methodologies Scrum / Kanban / Scaled Agile**
* Expertise in Agile Transformation, DevSecOps, AI integration
* Technically competent with Microsoft Office tools, JIRA, Azure DevOps, Confluence, MS Project, MIRO, AI tools
* Experience in leading New Product development (NPD) and Agile projects of varying size and complexity
* Experience in driving cultural change by championing an agile mindset and ensuring the organization is at the forefront of industry’s best practices
* Ability to manage program finances and ensure cost\-effectiveness
* Ability to develop and manage projects budget, schedule \& timeline and ability to drive program specific goals and actions to closure
* Demonstrated ability to work with all levels of management and understand the impact of a project to the overall business. Ownership mindset to foster culture of ownership and accountability
* Work with project teams to analyze current systems and processes and design a strategy for the adoption of agile best practices. Lead from the front, coach project team members, take initiative and implement changes.
* Being bold and Courageous to raise issues to upper management
* Effective communication, presentation skills. Ability to learn and collaborate with cross cultural project teams
* Good interpersonal skills, coaching and mentoring various engineering functional teams to build strong cross\-functional teams
* Self\-starter with a desire to make a significant impact on the product development process
* You have 4\-year degree from an accredited institution. Technical degree in engineering or computer science is preferred with **14\&\#43; years of overall industry experience.**
* You are a certified PMP certified project management professional \& Agile Certified (CSM/PSM/KMP/ PMI\-ACP/SAFe cert/ICP Agile cert) with **minimum 8\&\#43; yrs. of Project management, Scrum Master, Agile experience**
* Proven leadership, facilitation, coaching and mentoring skills with exceptional attention to detail


We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

title: Project Manager
description:
**Job Description**  

We are looking for a passionate associate to join the innovation team at NielsenIQ as a Project Manager. We are looking for an associate who has an interest in pursuing a career in the market research , is interested in innovation and working in a fun and energetic team. The role as a Project Manager will support our accelerated business growth in the Western Europe Region and will be situated in our (NIQ OFFICE) office.


At NielsenIQ, we put our clients at the centre of what we do, we work hard, and everyone contributes to a team environment of learning and fun. As a Project Manager, you will be supporting study and questionnaire set up and working closely with other internal teams to ensure smooth and quality project execution from survey programming through the delivery of data.

**Responsibilities**

* Responsible for coordinating projects and executing standard research studies.
* Accurately transferring client confirmed inputs into internal questionnaire authoring platforms ready for programming.
* Complete quality checks on research materials including questionnaire and survey links to ensure they are error\-free when sent to respondents.
* Manage \& update documents and materials across platforms
* Liaise with other client success team members, programming and vendors to ensure the progress of the project is well communicated and monitored to minimize disruption of delays
* Manage the sampling and quota requirements on the survey/router platform
* Adhere to strict timelines and proactively anticipate, troubleshoot, overcome and/or escalate

**A little about you**


Our Project Managers manage the consistent delivery of utmost quality data to our Analysts and are experts in project execution. The successful candidate will possess the following skills:

  

* Excellent English language skills \- including oral and written communication
* Attention to detail
* Openness and flexibility to change
* Be curious and open\-minded: Keen interest to learn and adapt new technology and platforms
* Critical thinking \& problem\-solving skills
* Organizational and time\-management skills \- the ability to multitask
* Excellent interpersonal skills
* Interest in marketing (particularly consumer product marketing) and research
* Flexible working hours (within reason) to help coordinate with other regions
* project challenges to ensure projects meet client requirements and are completed on time

  

**Qualifications**  

* Candidate must possess at least a University degree in any field
* Min 3\+ years exp
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Office e.g., Excel and PowerPoint
* Excellent command of written and spoken English. An added advantage for the ability to communicate in second language
* An effective communicator
* Good attention to detail \- high accuracy and thoroughness

  

**Additional Information** **Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee\-Assistance\-Program (EAP)
